and the graveyard committees are exploring whether there is sufficient interest in installing columbarium walls in burrane graveyard and knockerra graveyard. a columbarium wall is a permanent, freestanding structure. each wall contains recessed compartments called niches (instead of a plot), designed to respectfully hold 2+ cremation urns. many parishes install them to provide families with a dignified, long-term resting place for loved ones who choose cremation and as an alternative to burial. survey can be accessed by below link or qr code. it will be available on facebook page and social media as well as paper copies will be available at the back of the churches from this weekend.

history of clare youth clubs 1969-2026 a group has been formed to compile a history of youth clubs in clare from 1969-2026. we are hoping to make contact with all youth clubs throughout the county (1969 2026) who were active during those years. an information sheet will be distributed to each club contact person, and we ask you to please forward information to us by friday 30th october. please contact jim mcmahon
